description: Paper-convention aligned runs with J = h = 1, T in {1, 2}, r in {1, 2, 3, 7}, and square noise scaling.
sign_convention: Paper convention: rx = -h and rzz = -J, so rxT = -h*T and rzzT = -J*T.
notes: This directory stores the J = h = 1 counterpart of the historical r = [1, 2, 3, 7] square-noise scan.
Noise values use the r = [1, 2, 3, 7] square scale plus zero; the joint path should use the reversed nonzero sequence [49, 9, 4, 1].
The batch config maps rxT/rzzT into h/J at runtime using h = -rxT/T and J = -rzzT/T.
